messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx and client timeouts observed from eu-west-edge gateway starting ~1765432080. Error rate spike to ~8% p95 requests. Paging oncall.
Maya (SRE): I'm on it, taking P1. Creating incident channel and joining Zoom. ops-zoom-bot: https://zoom.redwood.zoom/incident-1765432100
Jamal (oncall): ack, standing by. Observing increased 504s and occasional 502s. Grafana panel shows gateway downstream latencies rising, queue depth ticked up.
Alex (Runtime): logging from runtime shows KV-cache misses spiking and backend model pods returning 504 on scale-up. Suspect model-worker CPU contention or network egress.
Priya (Network): I see a surge of TCP retransmits from eu-west edge to model nodes in eu-west1-b. Possible packet drops on the private peering. Investigating route health.
Sofia (Support): Notified top-5 customers on watchlist; collecting affected tenant IDs. Already received 2 tickets reporting timeouts from EU users.
Maya (SRE): Quick checklist: 1) traffic shaping/fallback rules? 2) circuit-breaker thresholds? 3) scale model pool? 4) route to eu-central as overflow?
Ethan (ProdOps): Circuit-breaker is at 10% 5xx by default; looks like gateway hasn't tripped yet. We can force-enable overflow to eu-central temporary.
Jamal (oncall): Before cross-region failover, try increasing model-worker replicas in eu-west by +50% and temporarily relax connection pooled timeouts to avoid dropping in-flight requests.
Alex (Runtime): Scaling command: ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-worker-eu-west --replicas=18``` logs show that autoscaler didn't kick fast enough for this burst.
Priya (Network): I've opened a ticket with cloud provider for packet drop, but we need immediate mitigation. Propose traffic split: 30% -> eu-central, 70% -> eu-west for next 15m.
Maya (SRE): Agreed. Jamal, can you apply weighted routing via traffic-router? Command snippet: ```routerctl set-weight eu-west1=70 eu-central1=30 --reason="mitigate-eu-west-packet-drops"```
Jamal (oncall): Applying now. ```> routerctl set-weight eu-west1=70 eu-central1=30 --ticket 12345``` Done. Monitoring.
incident-bot: Routing change detected by routerctl user Jamal (oncall) at 1765432234.
Sofia (Support): FYI to CS: we pushed 30% traffic to eu-central; customer-facing impact should reduce for EU users. Recommended note: intermittent timeouts for a small subset while we stabilize.
Ethan (ProdOps): Model-worker replicas scaling is progressing. New pods coming up, but warm cache required; expect some cold-start latency for a few minutes.
Alex (Runtime): To limit cold-start impact, I'm enabling prefix caching for critical tenants: ```runtime-config set prefix_cache=true --tenants=tenant_23,tenant_86```.
Maya (SRE): Can we also temporarily increase request timeout at gateway to allow slow booting workers finish instead of returning 504? Change: gateway timeout from 30s -> 60s for eu-west-only.
Jamal (oncall): Patching gateway config: ```configctl patch gateway/eu-west '{"timeout":60000}' --env=prod``` Patch applied at 1765432310.
Priya (Network): Cloud provider acknowledged transient peering flaps at 1765432322; they're seeing packet drops on one spine. Working on mitigation.
Sofia (Support): Customer impact list: tenant_23, tenant_86, tenant_141 reported >5% request failures. Notifying with status page update now.
Maya (SRE): Status page blip drafted: "We are experiencing elevated errors and timeouts in EU. Traffic is being partially routed to eu-central while we remediate."
incident-bot: Status page updated by Sofia (Support) at 1765432340.
Jamal (oncall): Metrics after routing change: overall EU error rate down from 8% -> 2.1% within 3m. p99 latency still elevated for some requests from tenant_141.
Alex (Runtime): Still seeing a subset of requests hitting eu-west model-workers that are behind in weight balancing due to sticky sessions. I'm going to evict sticky sessions for 10m: ```runtime-ctl session-evict --region eu-west --duration 10m```).
Ethan (ProdOps): Eviction applied. That should redistribute new requests to eu-central where warmed workers exist.
Priya (Network): Cloud fabric has mitigation deployed on their side, packet drops reduced to <0.5% at 1765432425.
Maya (SRE): Marking containment: traffic split + scaling + cache/prefix changes reduced customer-visible errors. Containment achieved at 1765432440. Moving to recovery steps.
Sofia (Support): Continuing customer comms: follow-up to impacted customers sent. CS asks for ETA on full restoration.
Alex (Runtime): ETA for full warm cache: ~8-12 minutes for heavy models. We'll monitor QPS, cache hit rate.
Jamal (oncall): I'm leaving the weighted routing for 30/70 for another 20m, then gradually pull back to 100% eu-west if stable.
incident-bot: Oncall handoff reminder: Jamal will remain primary for next 30 minutes, then Maya will take ownership for the postmortem.
Maya (SRE): noted. Preparing incident timeline and collecting logs: gateway logs, model-worker logs, routerctl audit, and cloud-provider network events.
Ethan (ProdOps): I'll run a quick smoke test across regions: ```curl -H "x-tenant: tenant_23" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -v``` Sample response: ```HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n... latency 480ms``` good from eu-central.
Sofia (Support): Any immediate customer escalations? None new. Support queue reduced after status update.
Alex (Runtime): Postmortem hypothesis: primary cause = transient peering packet drops causing retries and queue saturation on eu-west model-workers; secondary = autoscaler lag + sticky session behavior amplified impact.
Maya (SRE): Agreed. Action items for postmortem: 1) tune autoscaler thresholds for sudden traffic spikes, 2) implement faster proxy failover to alternate region, 3) reduce sticky session TTL or allow graceful session migration, 4) alerting refinement to detect network-level packet drop patterns earlier.
Jamal (oncall): Saving timeline & logs to incident-1765432100 folder. I'll tag ops-runbook and hand over to Maya for post-incident review.
incident-bot: Incident declared resolved for customer-impacting errors at 1765432440; monitoring continues until 1765432605.
Maya (SRE): Closing note: will schedule 1-hour postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Assigning owners: autoscale tuning -> Ethan, sticky sessions -> Alex, network alerting -> Priya, customer followups -> Sofia.
Sofia (Support): Thanks everyone. I'll update customers once we have postmortem summary.
Jamal (oncall): leaving Zoom. good handoff. :thumbsup:
ops-zoom-bot: Zoom meeting closed at 1765432610.
